headline: As of 2026-10-02: 1,075,912 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 28 of 50 states, D+34.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,075,912 early/mail ballots cast so far across 28 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+34.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (313,567), New Jersey (154,812), Florida (120,166).
